banners.prompt:
Create a NEW, finished Facebook/Instagram feed advertising banner for a Bulgarian audience, from scratch.
IMAGE 1 is only a blank grey canvas used for size: ignore its content completely. The photo/background must fill the WHOLE frame edge to edge (no bars, no borders, no frames).
LAYOUT SAFE ZONE (critical): the top 14% and the bottom 14% of the frame will be cut off afterwards. Put NOTHING important there - only continuation of the background. ALL text lines, faces, the book and the CTA button must be inside the middle 72% of the frame height. Keep about 6% side margins for text.
COMPOSITION NOTE: frame the shot wide enough that there is calm empty background above the headline and below the CTA button. The headline starts around 18-20% from the top; the CTA button sits around 80-86% and is fully visible with space under it.
SAFE ZONE (critical, stricter than usual): the final banner will be cropped to 4:5 from the CENTRE of this tall frame. Treat everything above 13% and below 87% of the frame height as bleed: only background there. The headline must start at about 17% and the bottom of the CTA button must be at about 83%.
EXACT VERTICAL LAYOUT (percent of the full frame height, from the top): 0-15% only background. 16-29% the headline (two lines). 30-39% the subheadline (two lines, big). 40-76% the scene. 77-83% the CTA button. 84-100% only background.
FORMAT: PAIN - a real photo of the exact moment of the problem (IMAGE 3 is our own winning PAIN banner - use it only for typography and layout, not its scene).
STOP-THE-SCROLL CONTRAST (critical): it must be instantly clear in a split second, even as a small thumbnail, that a CAT has DESTROYED a SOFA. Use strong complementary colours: a bright ORANGE ginger cat on a DEEP NAVY-BLUE (or royal blue) fabric sofa. The armrest is badly shredded: big torn holes with bright WHITE stuffing and foam bursting out and white fluff on the floor - the damage must be large and obvious. The cat is caught in the act, front claws in the torn armrest, looking straight at the camera with a guilty "it wasn't me" face. Keep the background simple, slightly darker and softly blurred so the orange cat and the white torn stuffing pop out. Ordinary Bulgarian living room, not luxury.
SCENE: In the softly blurred background a Bulgarian woman around 50 in home clothes stands with one hand on her forehead, tired and annoyed (secondary). On a small side table in the foreground lies the book (IMAGE 2), about 16% of the banner width, next to a cup of coffee.
TEXT ON THE BANNER (exactly these lines, nothing else):
1) Headline overlaid on the photo with a soft dark gradient behind it, white, two lines: "Котката пак ли ти съсипва дивана?" - make "съсипва дивана?" yellow #F5C518.
2) Subheadline under it, white, bold, big: "Ето как да я отучиш да драска мебелите. Без викане и спрейове."
3) CTA button: "Научи СЕГА👉"
IMAGE 2 is the real book cover of the book "Щастлива котка, щастлив стопанин" (it shows a 3D paperback mockup on white - use only the book itself, not the white background). Reproduce it exactly on the physical book: same design, colours and all cover lettering letter by letter. Do not invent or change any cover text.
TYPOGRAPHY RULES (critical):
- All text is Bulgarian Cyrillic. Render every text line EXACTLY as given, character by character, including punctuation, quotation marks and capital letters. Do not translate, correct, shorten, re-order or add any words.
- Use a heavy, clean, condensed sans-serif for headlines (like Oswald Bold / Bebas-style weight but with full Cyrillic).
- Text must be large and clearly legible on a phone at 380px width: headline lines at least ~6% of the banner height, subheadline at least ~4.8% of the banner height (bold, very easy to read on a phone), CTA text ~3.5%. Keep generous side margins (about 6% of the width).
- Strong contrast only: white or near-black text; accent words in warm yellow #F5C518; no grey text on dark backgrounds.
- CTA = rounded pill button in vivid red #E8232A with bold white text, centred near the bottom of the central area. The pointing-hand emoji at the end of the CTA is drawn as a small yellow pointing-right hand icon.
- No other text, logos, watermarks, prices, percentages or website addresses anywhere. No phone screens, no chat or messenger interface, no notification badges.

PHOTO STYLE: realistic, natural-looking photo like a real Bulgarian everyday scene taken with a good phone camera; natural light, real skin and fur texture; not glossy stock, no beauty filter. People have only two hands with five fingers each. The cat looks natural and healthy, no injuries, no blood.

BOOK REALISM (critical - the book must NOT look pasted in like a sticker or a product render): the book is a real, physically present paperback that belongs to the scene. It lies casually at an angle (not facing the camera straight, not standing upright like a display), lit by the SAME light as the scene, soft natural shadow, same depth of field, realistic size (a normal 13x20 cm paperback), slightly worn edges, partly overlapped by something (a cup, a pen, a hand or a cushion edge). The cover design and title must still be recognisable.

CRITICAL POSITION CHECK: the FIRST line of any text must start no higher than 17% of the frame height from the top. The CTA button must end no lower than 87% of the frame height.
NO extra text anywhere in the scene: no posters, signs, wall lettering or written papers besides the book cover.

IMAGE 1 is our existing finished banner. Recreate it as the same banner (same light-blue background with paw prints, same headline text and style, same book cover, same yellow arrow, same subheadline text, same red CTA button) with ONLY these changes:
1) The three round problem badges on the left must be MUCH BIGGER (each about 36% of the banner width) so they are clearly visible on a phone; the book may become a bit smaller (about 36% of the banner width) to make room. Keep the small red cross on each badge.
2) Replace the middle badge (the hand) with a ZERO-RISK image: a grey tabby cat playfully holding a person's hand with its front paws and gently nibbling a finger, ears slightly back - NO scratches, NO marks, NO red lines, NO blood, completely clean skin.
3) Make the subheadline "Системата P.U.R.R. променя лошите навици с награди, а не наказания." bigger and bold (at least ~4.8% of the banner height), on two lines.
4) Keep all text inside the frame with comfortable margins: nothing may touch the top or bottom edge; the headline starts at about 5% from the top and the CTA button ends at about 95% of THIS image.
All text is Bulgarian Cyrillic, rendered EXACTLY as in IMAGE 1, character by character. No other changes, no new text, no prices.

IMAGE 1 is our existing finished banner. Recreate it as the SAME banner - same woman, same sleeping grey tabby cat, same living room, same book on the table, same headline, same red CTA button - with ONLY this change: make the subheadline "Без надраскани мебели, хапане и „изненади“ по килима" much bigger and bold (at least ~4.8% of the banner height), on two lines, near-black, centred under the headline. Move the scene slightly down if needed. Keep all text inside the frame with comfortable margins: nothing may touch the top or bottom edge; the headline starts at about 5% from the top and the CTA button ends at about 95% of THIS image.
All text is Bulgarian Cyrillic, rendered EXACTLY as in IMAGE 1, character by character (keep the Bulgarian quotation marks „ “ exactly, no full stop at the end of the subheadline). No other changes, no new text, no prices.
